items.informal_name: Numerical Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that takes a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and another natural number $m$, returning a natural number used to establish well-founded recursion in the context of multivariate polynomials and Chevalley's theorem. It computes bounds by recursively applying $f$ to $n$ and decrementing $m$.

items.informal_name: Degree Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that computes a degree bound for multivariate polynomials, taking a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and an element of the sum type $\mathbb{N} \oplus \mathbb{N}$. For left components, it applies $f$ to $n$, and for right components, it returns $n$ directly. This is used in the proof of Chevalley's theorem to establish well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomial constructions.

items.informal_name: Monotonicity of Degree Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.type:
∀ {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} {D₁ D₂ : ℕ → ℕ},
  k₁ ≤ k₂ →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      (∀ i < n, D₁ i ≤ D₂ i) → ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k₁ D₁ n ≤ ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k₂ D₂ n
items.informal_description: For natural numbers $k_1 \leq k_2$, functions $D_1, D_2 : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfying $D_1(i) \leq D_2(i)$ for all $i < n$, and any $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the degree bound computed with parameters $k_1$ and $D_1$ at $n$ is less than or equal to the degree bound computed with parameters $k_2$ and $D_2$ at $n$, i.e., $\text{degBound}(k_1, D_1, n) \leq \text{degBound}(k_2, D_2, n)$.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound on Weighted Order of Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For any extended natural number $n$, if every monomial $d$ with $\text{weight}(w, d) < n$ has zero coefficient in the multivariate power series $f$, then $n \leq \text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$, where $\text{weightedOrder}(f, w)$ denotes the weighted order of $f$ with respect to the weight function $w$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Upper Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if the coefficient of a monomial $ d $ in $ f $ is non-zero, then the weighted order of $ f $ is less than or equal to the weight of $ d $, i.e., $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}_w(f) \leq \sum_{i \in \operatorname{support} d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Lower Bound for Multivariate Power Series
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → ↑n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, if every monomial $ d $ with weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) < n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $, then the weighted order of $ f $ with respect to $ w $ satisfies $ n \leq \text{weightedOrder}_w(f) $.
